description: W holds row 1 with every scalar type set, row 2 with every field Null but ID, and row 3 with a 3000-character Memo. For a table-type, a dynaset, a snapshot and a forward-only recordset over W: GetRows(3), then read BOF, EOF and ID. Then GetRows(3) on a dynaset, a snapshot and a forward-only recordset over "SELECT ID, Cu * 2 AS CuX, Dt + 1 AS DtX, Tx & 'x' AS TxX, Bo AND True AS BoX FROM W" and GetRows(2) over WD (a Decimal field) in a table-type, a dynaset and a snapshot. Asks the VARIANT type of each cell per field type and source (Boolean, Byte, Integer, Currency, Double, Single, Date, Text, Memo, Decimal, Null), the Memo length returned, and the array dimensions. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
